scope: Focused Lean packaging experiment with cached external imports; not a clean xv6 or Lake build benchmark. Service runtime excludes shared-lock waiting.
generation: Topologically concatenate authored source snapshots; remove internal imports, put external imports at top, wrap each source in section, alpha-rename private local declarations per source. Authored modules and production files unchanged.
validation: Bundles do not import selected source modules, checked via transitive source imports. Full COPYOUT declaration absent before elaboration; generated compiled_copyout checked with exactly37 axioms, all in the existing MixedAction.sound production baseline, and no sorryAx.
limitations: Three-module pilot recorded source hashes but predates external artifact hash recording.
Twenty-module comparison holds source and direct external artifact hashes fixed and includes import-only controls.

Full55module modular baseline is a source-hash-matched cross-run sum, not a paired same-environment clean rebuild. Three missing timings measured from frozen snapshots after full bundle, when frontend macros could have been added to cached imports.
Import-only controls approximate startup/loading/export overhead; subtracting them is not a direct Lean internal phase profile.
Generated source snapshots and logs are in .lake/whole-function/bundles; manifests identify exact sources and git ref.
